captions.help.slots.bookofbonanza.objects.book: Book symbol plays as a wild and 4+ scatters will trigger bonus round.
captions.help.slots.bookofbonanza.payline.rules.d: Prizes are awarded for matching combinations of symbols. Combinations must appear from left to right on a line, except for scatters. Only the highest win on each line and for each scatter combination is paid. Scatter wins and line wins are combined. The paytable displays prizes for the currently selected bet amount. Book Scatter symbols can substitute any paying symbol during the game
captions.help.slots.bookofbonanza.bonus.feature.d:
4 or more book scatters on the screen trigger 10 free games with a special expanding symbol. The special expanding symbol cannot be substituted by a scatter symbol during Free games.
One special expanding symbol is randomly selected at the start of the Free games. During Free Games and after the payout of regular symbols, the special symbol may expand to cover 3 positions on the reel and pays like the regular symbol, even on non-adjacent positions and on all lines played (expanding is only triggered if enough symbols for a win are present).
Every time a player hits 3 or more Book scatter symbols during Free games, they will win an extra 10 Free spins, and the expanding bonus symbol will remain the same.
Players can use the Buy Bonus Feature to buy the Free Games Round at a specified price.
captions.help.slots.bookofbonanza.B+.feature.head: B+ BET Feature Guide:
captions.help.slots.bookofbonanza.B+.feature.desc: Activate or deactivate the Bonus Bet feature using the B+ button in the game lobby. Enabling this feature incurs an additional cost of 25% of the total bet. Note that the added B+ value does not impact symbol payouts in both the basic and bonus games
captions.help.slots.bookofbonanza.B+.feature.guid: The B+ feature lets players accumulate scatters exclusively during the base game. Upon collecting 100 scatters at a specific bet amount, players automatically trigger a free bonus game. The B+ feature also introduces the "Bonus Gamble" option. When the B+ Progress Bar reaches 10%, players can engage in the Gamble game. The outcome, whether a win or lose, is determined by the progress bar percentage.
captions.help.slots.bookofbonanza.riskgame.featur: During the Bonus Risk game, a wheel appears on the screen. Spinning the wheel can result in either a winning green sector, awarding a Free Bonus Game, or a losing red sector, leading players back to the base game. Regardless of the outcome, the progress bar is reset after each Bonus Risk game spin.

The cost of a Bonus Risk game spin aligns with the bet amount used to accumulate Progress Bar percentages. If a player lacks sufficient funds, an error pop-up prompts them to add funds. Losing in the Bonus Risk game grants an extra spin in the base game, while winning rewards players with a bonus-winning spin.
Landing 4+ Scatters during the base game triggers the bonus game immediately — it does not add to the B+ Progress Bar. The Progress Bar fills separately from base game events and, at 100%, triggers its own single bonus game.
